sentence_stem: The old bridge was closed last month,
correct_completion: so drivers now use the new road.
full_sentence: The old bridge was closed last month, so drivers now use the new road.
acceptable_variants: so traffic has moved to the new road.
so the new road is now busy every morning.

options.text: drivers still use it every day.
options.why_wrong: This describes continued use, which contradicts the idea that the bridge was closed last month.

options.text: so drivers now use the new road.

options.why_wrong: This makes no sense, because a bridge cannot build people, and the sentence needs a logical result of the closure.

options.text: so the new road is being closed by drivers.
options.why_wrong: This reverses the logic of the passive: drivers do not close roads, so this completion does not follow from the closure.

grammar_focus: Passive voice in past and present tenses, showing the result of an action
explanation: Passive sentences focus on what is affected by the action. The completion should show the result for drivers after the closure, not reverse who performs the action.
translation: A ponte antiga foi fechada no mês passado, então os motoristas agora usam a nova estrada.
